definition: Whether the committed product, service, work, transaction, or other market activity reached its required completion or acceptance state.
The degree to which delivery, response, milestone, availability, or other performance occurred within the required or expected time window.
The degree to which delivered work, products, services, or results met defined quality, specification, defect, accuracy, or conformance expectations.
The degree to which the activity achieved the intended functional, operational, programmatic, mission, or beneficiary result.
The realized cost, savings, revenue, return, price performance, economic value, or other financial effect associated with the activity or decision.
The extent to which an intended user, customer, participant, organization, or market adopted, consumed, used, or sustained the delivered capability or result.
The observed satisfaction, experience, confidence, trust, accessibility, or other stakeholder-perceived effect associated with delivery or use.
The realized safety, incident, loss, exposure, resilience, security, or other risk-related result associated with the activity or decision.
Whether the delivered activity or result satisfied applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, policy, credential, audit, or standards obligations.
The realized environmental, resource-efficiency, emissions, waste, circularity, conservation, or other sustainability effect associated with delivery or use.
The realized ability of an organization, system, network, facility, workforce, or supply chain to sustain, absorb, scale, recover, or continue required performance.
The realized learning, process improvement, capability enhancement, innovation, or other positive change generated through the activity and suitable for future market learning.
